description: This file defines the EntityUniqueProperty class, which implements a validation rule in the OrangeHRM system to ensure that a specific property of an entity is unique within the database. The class constructs and executes database queries to check for existing entities with the same property value, considering optional matching and ignoring certain values.

classes.name: EntityUniqueProperty
classes.description: A validation class to check for the uniqueness of a property of a given entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the entity name, property, and optional matching options.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the validation by querying the database to verify if the entity property value is unique, considering match and ignore options.
